brief: How we got our first 100 customers — no ads, no SEO, just 6 channels.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.headline: How We Landed 100 Customers Without Ads
slots.body: We skipped paid ads and SEO entirely. Here are the six organic channels that built our first 100 customers.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Start With Your Inner Circle
slots.body: Our first 20 customers came from friends and former colleagues. Don't underestimate your existing network.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: LinkedIn Direct Outreach
slots.body: We sent 50 personalized DMs daily to our ideal buyer persona. Context beats copy-paste every time.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Niche Online Communities
slots.body: Slack groups, Reddit threads, and Discord servers were goldmines. We gave value before pitching anything.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Build Strategic Micro-Partnerships
slots.body: We co-hosted webinars with complementary tools. Their audience became our audience overnight.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Hyper-Targeted Cold Email
slots.body: Scraping was out; manual research was in. Every email referenced a specific recent company milestone.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Engineer Word of Mouth
slots.body: We gave every happy user a simple referral link. Incentives turned customers into our sales team.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.headline: Which Channel Will You Test First?
slots.body: Drop your biggest growth challenge below. I read every comment.
